newsitem.title: DENMARK: RC says Orrfors deal not tied to buyout.
newsitem.headline: RC says Orrfors deal not tied to buyout.

text.p: Danish porcelain and silver group Royal Copenhagen on Tuesday denied a newspaper report that it might drop its alliance with Sweden's Orrefors Kosta Boda if it failed to win control of the company.

"It is a long-term alliance we have formed and it is not a condition for this co-operation that we have a majority holding in Orrefors Kosta Boda, I can unequivocally deny that, Royal Copenhagen Managing Director Leonhard Schroeder told Reuters.
The Swedish daily Dagens Nyheter said Tuesday that Swedish firm Proventus AB's efforts to buy a majority stake in Orrefors endangered the export sales agreement with Royal Copenhagen.

Royal Copenhagen, 82 percent owned by Danish brewer Carlsberg, this month raised to 17.1 percent its holding in upmarket glassmaker Orrefors, in what an executive said was a mark of good faith after the joint sales agreement.
The move prompted Proventus to seek to raise its own stake in Orrefors while warning that it suspected Royal Copenhagen of trying to bring the prestigious Kosta Boda label under Danish control.
